briefing.headline: RRC plunges 27.6% in overnight sell‑off
briefing.summary: Big‑cap tech stocks led the decline, with AMD, NVDA, META, AMZN, MSFT and TSLA all down 2‑4% and the Nasdaq‑focused QQQ and S&P 500 ETF SPY slipping as well. Only a handful of smaller caps bucked the trend, notably SNDQ (+12.5%) and SSPC (+11.8%). The breadth was thin – 9 of the 10 core tickers fell while just one edged higher. Overall market pressure was evident across sectors.

macro_context.detail: Major US indices fell overnight, with SPY down 0.6% and QQQ down 1.3%.
